watches.name: Pedral Contour
watches.description: The Contour doesn't sit on the wrist. It wraps it. Hundreds of articulated links move like fabric, finished with the care of a fine bracelet and shaped to form one continuous line from clasp to dial. Something meant to be touched as much as read.

specsRaw.Movement: Ronda 1063, Swiss-made quartz — or ETA 7001, Swiss hand-wound, 2.5mm calibre height
specsRaw.Case: 35mm · 6.9mm thin · fully integrated scale-bracelet construction · 316L stainless steel (Aurum: gold-plated 316L stainless steel)
specsRaw.Dial: Quartz: Aurum, natural lapis lazuli flecked with gold pyrite, no two dials alike. Hand-Wound: Onyx — a single sheet of genuine black onyx stone, cut in the same squarcle silhouette.
specsRaw.Bracelet: Fully integrated, hundreds of brushed scales, no visible lugs
specsRaw.Edition: Third drop · Nacre now fully allocated. Aurum and Onyx carry over from the second drop. The 39mm dials continue as Silhouette.
specsRaw.The larger 39mm case is now its own watc: Silhouette — the same integrated idea in a new proportion, on the Nyoka weave bracelet.

watches.name: Pedral Maestro
watches.description: At 37mm, the monobloc tonneau case and fluted bezel frame the dial. A detail most will pass over. The same architecture comes in two expressions: the classic Maestro, with a textured sunburst dial, lumed Roman numerals and central seconds — and the Petite Seconde, with a guilloché dial, proprietary Roman numerals and a subsidiary seconds at six o'clock.

specsRaw.Movement: Classic dials: Sellita SW200-1b · Petite Seconde: Sellita SW260 with small seconds · Swiss automatic · 38-hour power reserve
specsRaw.Case: 37mm tonneau · 9.8mm slim · 47.5mm lug-to-lug · 316L stainless steel · HV1200 scratch-resistant coating
specsRaw.Dial: Lapis No.1: sunburst guilloché, Roman numerals, central seconds · Soul Blue & Aura Gold (Petite Seconde): guilloché, proprietary Roman numerals, small seconds at 6 o'clock
specsRaw.Crystal: Sapphire front & back · 5× internal AR coating · scratch-resistant
specsRaw.Bracelet: Integrated hexagonal links · 22.5mm at lugs, tapers to 18mm · HV1200 coating · quick-release
specsRaw.Lume: Swiss Super-LumiNova® BGW9 on hands and indices (classic dials)
specsRaw.Edition: Limited per dial · Each piece individually numbered · Never reissued
specsRaw.VAT: Included for EU orders · Duties and taxes outside EU not included
specsRaw.Read: Watches and Art: Best of Both Worlds — The Boris Pjanić Capsule

watches.name: Pedral Silhouette
watches.description: Silhouette carries the same idea as Contour: a case and bracelet built as one continuous form, with no break in the line from lug to crown. Here it comes in a new proportion and a new weave. 39mm in diameter and 47.5mm lug to lug, it has a larger, more present footprint than Contour, and at 7.3mm thin the slimness that defines the line carries over. Built in 316L stainless steel, with the same integrated collar fusing case to bracelet.

specsRaw.Price: Ophion: €1,500 Japanese · €2,200 Swiss · €2,200 Aventurine · €5,000 Ituri (fully allocated)
specsRaw.Movement: Hand-wound · Swiss: La Joux-Perret LJP D101, 50-hour power reserve · Japanese (Ophion only): Miyota 9015 converted by Pedral from automatic to hand-winding
specsRaw.Case: 39mm · 47.5mm lug to lug · 7.3mm thin · 316L stainless steel (Ituri: gold-plated) · integrated collar fusing case to bracelet
specsRaw.Dial: Ophion (purple): the Nyoka weave carried across the dial, pressed in real raised and recessed relief with a sunburst finish, no indices, no logo · Aventurine: natural stone with hand-set moissanite baguette indices · Ituri: hand-fired gold cloisonné enamel carrying the Okapi motif

watches.name: Pedral Triomphe
watches.description: The Triomphe is a single architecture, expressed through an evolving series of dial editions. 38mm wide, 8.8mm thin. Each release is limited, allocation-based, and built for those who know exactly what they want.

specsRaw.Movement: Sellita SW210-1B · Swiss hand-wound · Regulated ±5 s/day in 5 positions
specsRaw.Dial: Multi-layer guilloché (Carreau Tissé · sauté piqué · Vagues de Lumière) or natural stone, edition-dependent
specsRaw.Hands: Diamond-cut · Applied Roman numerals · Hebrew & Eastern Arabic numerals available made to order
specsRaw.Edition: 20 pieces per dial variant · Never reissued · By allocation
specsRaw.Two dial expressions. The guilloché: Carreau Tissé centre, satinée circulaire and sauté piqué borders, Vagues de Lumière moiré frame. Three recessed rings reference the Arc de Triomphe. The stone dial: each one unrepeatable. When an edition closes, it closes.
specsRaw.Read: Three Scripts, One Watch: Why the Triomphee Speaks in Roman, Hebrew and Eastern Arabic

watches.name: Pedral Étiquette
watches.description: There are certain rules in watchmaking. Rules of proportion, symmetry, restraint and good taste. Étiquette acknowledges them — then politely ignores a few. Drawing from the architectural elegance of the Art Deco era, it reimagines the rectangular dress watch through exaggerated proportions, sculptural detailing and a healthy disregard for convention. At 27 × 43.7 mm, built on the golden ratio, and 6.9–7.3 mm thick (preliminary), its silhouette is deliberately unconventional: slim, elegant and slightly eccentric.

specsRaw.Movement: La Joux-Perret LJP D101 · Swiss hand-wound · Hours and minutes · 50-hour power reserve
specsRaw.Case: 27 × 43.7mm · Golden ratio proportions · 6.9–7.3mm thick (preliminary) · Curved to follow the wrist · Subtly asymmetrical rectangle · 316L stainless steel
specsRaw.Case Detail: Concentric CNC-machined grooves · Brushed surfaces, polished bevels
specsRaw.Dial: Pedral signature inner dial frame · Soirée (black onyx, gold numerals) and Bourgogne: custom distorted Roman numerals · Nocturne (black onyx) and Ambiance: musical-note indices · Famille Royale (Royal Aubergine lacquer, champagne-gold numerals) reserved for existing owners
specsRaw.Strap: Premium leather, lizard-pattern or Epsom · 20mm tapering to 18mm · Custom-fitted concealed lugs · Polished pin buckle
specsRaw.Status: Pre-order · Estimated delivery late Q1 / early Q2 2027, in order of purchase · Final specifications subject to prototype development
specsRaw.Estimated delivery: late Q1 / early Q2 2027 · Delivered in order of purchase

watches.name: Pedral Okapi Classique
watches.description: The Okapi is defined by balance and restraint. Its 37mm cushion case combines rounded contours with precise architectural lines — a silhouette that reads as neither vintage nor modern. The watch that began the studio.

specsRaw.Movement: ETA 7001 or La Joux-Perret LJP7380 · Swiss hand-wound · La Chaux-de-Fonds manufacture · Choice of calibre at reservation
specsRaw.Case: 37mm cushion-shaped · 7mm thin · 47mm lug-to-lug · 18mm lug width · 316L stainless steel · HV1200 scratch-resistant coating
specsRaw.Dial: Deep blue frosted finish · Coin-edge fluted flange · Guilloché small seconds at 6 o'clock
specsRaw.Chapter Ring: Slim steel with fine lacquer-filled markings
specsRaw.Strap: 18mm quick-release leather with butterfly clasp · Integrated steel bracelet option
specsRaw.Caseback: Engraved "Designed in Sweden" · Sapphire exhibition window
specsRaw.Edition: 20 pieces · First run · Allocation-based · 3–6 months delivery
specsRaw.Read: The Okapi Returns: Reimagining the Watch That Started Everything

collections.name: Six watches. One designer.
collections.description: Explore all Pedral watch collections — Contour, Silhouette, Maestro, Triomphe, Okapi Classique, and the new Étiquette. Six watches. One independent designer. Worn in 30+ countries.

collections.name: Contour
collections.description: Contour: a 35mm, 6.9mm integrated-bracelet watch. €895 quartz, €1,000 Aurum, €1,950 hand-wound Onyx. Stockholm-designed. Third drop now available.

collections.name: Étiquette
collections.description: Étiquette: a 27 × 43.7mm golden-ratio rectangular dress watch, 6.9–7.3mm (preliminary), with concentric CNC-machined grooves and custom distorted Roman numerals. Swiss hand-wound LJP D101, €1,800. Pre-order now.

collections.name: Maestro
collections.description: A 37mm tonneau dress watch with a Sellita Swiss automatic movement — central seconds from €1,450, or the Petite Seconde with small seconds at €1,600. Stockholm-designed by an independent Swedish maker. No restocks.

collections.name: Triomphe
collections.description: An 8.8mm ultra-thin dress watch with a Sellita Swiss hand-wound movement. Stockholm-designed by an independent Swedish maker. Editions of 20, no restocks.

collections.name: Silhouette
collections.description: Silhouette: a 39mm integrated-bracelet watch on the Nyoka weave, 7.3mm thin. New woven dial Ophion, hand-wound — Japanese €1,500, Swiss LJP D101 €2,200. Aventurine with hand-set moissanite, €2,200. Stockholm-designed.

collections.name: Okapi Classique
collections.description: A 37mm cushion dress watch. ETA 7001 or La Joux-Perret LJP7380 Swiss hand-wound. Stockholm-designed, independent Swedish maker. Edition of 20.

collections.name: Contour × Seconds Society
collections.description: A 15-piece capsule collaboration with Seconds Society. Contour's integrated-bracelet quartz platform in a Sodalite dial. €895. Stockholm-designed.
